title: Vanilla Intense
description: A feature-rich survival server with progression, economy, and rewards.
body:
# Vanilla Intense
A modern **Vanilla+ survival experience** focused on progression, economy, and player interaction.
Earn rewards, unlock cosmetics, level up your skills, and explore a world unlike anything in vanilla Minecraft.

> 🚀 **Launching May 1st at 3:00 PM MESZ!**
> Join us on day one and help shape the future of the server.

⚠️ **Vanilla Intense is currently in active development.**
The server is constantly evolving — new content, systems, and improvements are added regularly based on community feedback. Join early and help shape the direction of the server.

## 🌍 A World Reborn
Vanilla Intense runs on a fully custom-generated world powered by **Dungeons and Taverns** and the complete **DnT Structure Overhaul** pack series — completely reimagining nearly every structure in the game, including Ancient Cities, Mineshafts, Strongholds, Ocean Monuments, Nether Fortresses, and more.

## ⚔️ Current Features
* 📈 **Skills & leveling** — master 15+ skills, from Farming to Forging (AuraSkills)
* 💧 **Mana system** — use mana-powered abilities tied to your skill level
* 🎁 **Daily rewards** — log in, claim rewards, and progress every day (AxRewards)
* ✨ **Unlockable cosmetics** — hats, effects, gadgets, and more (UltraCosmetics)
* 🎣 **Custom fishing** — hundreds of unique fish, rarities, baits, and fishing tournaments (EvenMoreFish)
* 💰 **Player shops** — buy and sell items with a player-driven economy (QuickShop)
* 🗺️ **Live world map** — explore the world in your browser via BlueMap
* 💬 **Discord integration** — server chat linked directly to Discord (DiscordSRV)
* 🪦 **Death graves** — never lose your items on death (AxGraves)
* 🛡️ **Claim & grief protection** — secure your builds and land
* 🌳 **Auto Tree Chop** — chop an entire tree with a single swing
* 🪑 **Sit anywhere** — relax on stairs and slabs
* 🌐 **Multi-server network** — seamless lobby & survival split, with more servers planned
* 🔢 **Multi-version support** — join from Minecraft 1.7.2 up to the latest release
* 📱 **Bedrock support** — play on mobile, console, or Windows Edition

## 🚧 Coming Soon
* 💰 Player-driven economy with shops
* ⛏️ Veinminer — mine entire ore veins at once
* ⚒️ Jobs system — choose a profession, earn income
* 🏆 Skill & fishing leaderboards

Join early, shape the server, and experience **Vanilla — but more intense.**
